title: ThemeState
description: The shape of the theme signalStore state exposed by feature 003. 'choice' is the stored preference (or 'system' when absent/invalid); 'effective' is the resolved palette that must match the document-root marker. 'choice' is persisted under the 'lockr.theme' key per the 002 contract (theme-choice.schema.json); 'effective' is derived and never persisted.

choice.description: The current theme choice. 'system' means the effective theme is whatever the OS preference resolves to, live.

effective.description: The resolved palette. When 'choice' is 'system', this follows the live prefers-color-scheme match; otherwise it equals the explicit choice.
